parameters.name: DBClusterDescription
parameters.description: The description of the cluster. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: DBClusterIds
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBClusterStatus
parameters.description: The state of the cluster that you want to query. For information about valid values, see [Cluster states](~~99286~~).

parameters.name: DBNodeIds
parameters.description: The ID of the node. You can specify multiple node IDs. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description:
The database engine that the cluster runs. Valid values:

*   **MySQL**
*   **PostgreSQL**
*   **Oracle**

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version of the cluster.

parameters.name: DescribeType
parameters.description:
The query mode of the list. The value Simple indicates that the simple mode is used. In this mode, only the basic metadata information of the cluster is returned.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the detailed mode is used by default. Detailed information about the cluster is returned.

parameters.name: Expired
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the INTEGER data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**.

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go
*   **Prepaid**: subscription

parameters.name: RecentCreationInterval
parameters.description: Filters clusters created in the last N days. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: RecentExpirationInterval
parameters.description: Filters clusters that expire after N days. Valid values: 0 to 15.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the cluster.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query the available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-clusters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids pc-0000000000000000 --db-cluster-description pc-0000000000000000 --connection-string 00000000.rwlb.polardb-pg-public.rds.aliyuncs.com --db-cluster-status Running --db-type MySQL --describe-type Simple --db-version 5.6 --recent-creation-interval 7 --recent-expiration-interval 6 --expired true --page-size 30 --page-number 10 --resource-group-id rg-0000000000 --tag Value=5.6 Key=MySQL --pay-type Postpaid --db-node-ids pi-000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeDBClusters --region cn-hangzhou --DescribeType Simple --Tag.1.Key MySQL --DBNodeIds 'pi-000000000000000' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-0000000000' --DBClusterStatus Running --DBClusterDescription 'pc-0000000000000000' --Expired true --DBType MySQL --PayType Postpaid --RecentCreationInterval 7 --DBVersion '5.6' --DBClusterIds 'pc-0000000000000000' --PageNumber 10 --Tag.1.Value '5.6' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ConnectionString '00000000.rwlb.polardb-pg-public.rds.aliyuncs.com' --RecentExpirationInterval 6
